svg.text: Code - Payment adapter in Orders API (fictional example)
Scope = the Payment adapter component in Orders API. Boxes show an interface, classes, and selected methods.
Hollow triangle with dashed line = interface realization. Dashed arrow = code dependency.
This is a UML Code view, not a set of new software systems or runtime containers.
Sizes accommodate content and carry no extra architectural meaning. Neutral relationship colors add no extra
meaning. Arrowheads indicate the labeled direction.
Exact C4 shapes require the native draw.io companion; Mermaid syntax cannot import the native assets.
